ramayana-6-11-11.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 11: Vibhishana arrives and asks Rama for refuge; Sugriva suspects him, and Rama asks his counsellors' views.

ramayana-6-11-12.translation: "With many reasons and words I showed him again and again: 'Let Sita be properly returned to Rama.'"
ramayana-6-11-12.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 11: Vibhishana arrives and asks Rama for refuge; Sugriva suspects him, and Rama asks his counsellors' views.

ramayana-6-11-13.translation: "But Ravana, driven by fate, did not accept the good words spoken to him, like a dying man refusing medicine."
ramayana-6-11-13.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 11: Vibhishana arrives and asks Rama for refuge; Sugriva suspects him, and Rama asks his counsellors' views.

ramayana-6-11-14.translation: "Spoken to harshly by him and insulted like a slave, I have left my sons and wives and come to Raghava for refuge."
ramayana-6-11-14.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 11: Vibhishana arrives and asks Rama for refuge; Sugriva suspects him, and Rama asks his counsellors' views.

ramayana-6-11-15.translation: "Tell great Raghava, refuge of all the worlds, quickly that I, Vibhishana, have come."
ramayana-6-11-15.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 11: Vibhishana arrives and asks Rama for refuge; Sugriva suspects him, and Rama asks his counsellors' views.

ramayana-6-11-16.translation: Hearing these words, swift Sugriva, agitated, spoke to Rama in front of Lakshmana.
ramayana-6-11-16.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 11: Vibhishana arrives and asks Rama for refuge; Sugriva suspects him, and Rama asks his counsellors' views.

ramayana-6-11-17.translation: "Ravana's younger brother, known as Vibhishana, has come to you for refuge with four rakshasas."
ramayana-6-11-17.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 11: Vibhishana arrives and asks Rama for refuge; Sugriva suspects him, and Rama asks his counsellors' views.

ramayana-6-11-18.translation: "Know that Vibhishana has been sent by Ravana. I think it right to seize him, best of the patient."
ramayana-6-11-18.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 11: Vibhishana arrives and asks Rama for refuge; Sugriva suspects him, and Rama asks his counsellors' views.

ramayana-6-11-19.translation: "This rakshasa has come with crooked intent, sent to strike, hidden by illusion, when you trust him, Raghava."
ramayana-6-11-19.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 11: Vibhishana arrives and asks Rama for refuge; Sugriva suspects him, and Rama asks his counsellors' views.

ramayana-6-11-20.translation: "Let him be punished severely with his ministers, for this Vibhishana is the brother of cruel Ravana."
ramayana-6-11-20.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 11: Vibhishana arrives and asks Rama for refuge; Sugriva suspects him, and Rama asks his counsellors' views.

ramayana-6-11-21.translation: Having said this to Rama, the agitated army commander, skilled in speech, fell silent before the eloquent one.
ramayana-6-11-21.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 11: Vibhishana arrives and asks Rama for refuge; Sugriva suspects him, and Rama asks his counsellors' views.

ramayana-6-11-22.translation: Hearing Sugriva's words, mighty Rama spoke to the monkeys near him, led by Hanuman.
ramayana-6-11-22.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 11: Vibhishana arrives and asks Rama for refuge; Sugriva suspects him, and Rama asks his counsellors' views.

ramayana-6-11-23.translation: "You too have heard the very reasoned words the monkey king has spoken about Ravana's younger brother."
ramayana-6-11-23.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 11: Vibhishana arrives and asks Rama for refuge; Sugriva suspects him, and Rama asks his counsellors' views.

ramayana-6-11-24.translation: "In times of difficulty a wise, good and able friend, who wishes lasting good, should give counsel."
ramayana-6-11-24.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 11: Vibhishana arrives and asks Rama for refuge; Sugriva suspects him, and Rama asks his counsellors' views.

ramayana-6-11-25.translation: Asked thus, they eagerly gave their own views to Rama, with courtesy, wishing his good.
ramayana-6-11-25.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 11: Vibhishana arrives and asks Rama for refuge; Sugriva suspects him, and Rama asks his counsellors' views.

ramayana-6-11-26.translation: "There is nothing in the three worlds unknown to you, Raghava. You ask us out of friendship, honouring us, Rama."
ramayana-6-11-26.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 11: Vibhishana arrives and asks Rama for refuge; Sugriva suspects him, and Rama asks his counsellors' views.

ramayana-6-11-27.translation: "You are true to your vows, brave, righteous, firm in valour, acting after testing, thoughtful, and you open yourself to your friends."
ramayana-6-11-27.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 11: Vibhishana arrives and asks Rama for refuge; Sugriva suspects him, and Rama asks his counsellors' views.

ramayana-6-11-28.translation: "So let your counsellors speak one by one, wise and able, giving reasons again and again."
ramayana-6-11-28.explanation: Yuddha Kanda, chapter 11: Vibhishana arrives and asks Rama for refuge; Sugriva suspects him, and Rama asks his counsellors' views.
